name: io.github.tonyyang0504/tiki-mcp
description: Tiki (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool m

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKI_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: App id of an IN-HOUSE application registered on the Tiki Open Platform and connected to your seller store (in-house apps receive the seller's permissions via the client-credentials flow).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKI_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: App secret of the same application; sent with the id as HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic) to https://api.tiki.vn/sc/oauth2/token. Apps configured for client_secret_post are not supported by this adapter.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKI_WAREHOUSE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Seller warehouse id (GET /integration/v2/sellers/me/warehouses) whose available quantity set_inventory writes.
